name: graphics-encoder
description: SS11.4 - the adopted encoder stack on non-photographic content. The selection weights were trained on natural-image orientation statistics: aniso penalizes diagonals, sel_hv breaks H/V symmetry. Screenshots, charts and text are far more axis-aligned than photographs, so the weights could help more there or could be actively wrong. scale_fit and ac_nearest are content-independent in principle and are included as a control. Run with forceOpaque: two images in this corpus carry an alpha channel and would otherwise encode in alpha mode, where none of the arms' opaque-layout overrides apply — they would contribute an identical constant to every arm, diluting every delta and biasing the test toward 'no difference'.

variants.label: pre-adoption (all off)
variants.tune: l1=26:5 c=9:4 aniso=0 sel_hv=0 scale_fit=0 ac_nearest=0
